statement_nl: Assume now that a < b. Define Lambda_b := Q[e_1,...,e_b] with deg(e_i) = i, define R_{a,b} := Lambda_b/(e_1,...,e_a), and define h_t by (sum_{i=0}^b (-1)^i e_i z^i)(sum_{t>=0} h_t z^t) = 1 with e_0 := 1; let bar h_t be the image of h_t in R_{a,b}. Then R_{a,b} is a positively graded Q-algebra with finite-dimensional graded pieces, Hilb(R_{a,b};q) = 1 / product_{i=a+1}^{b} (1 - q^i), and for each i with a + 1 <= i <= b the element bar h_{r+i} is homogeneous of degree r + i.
